facility_roles.note: The design report's own alternative title names the Tevatron as the source machine; no source fetched this session gives a numeric beam energy or explicitly says 'fixed-target proton beam extracted from the Tevatron', so this is recorded as approximate rather than verified.

intervals.note: Marks a dated point of active data analysis/results, not a run start or end boundary.

intervals.label: completed
intervals.note: No source fetched this session states an explicit end-of-data-taking date for KTeV (commonly cited elsewhere as two run periods, 1996-1997 and 1999-2000, but that specific breakdown was not confirmed by a source fetched in this session, so it is not asserted as a dated interval). 2000 is a rough lower bound inferred from the 1999 CP-violation result being reported as the experiment's landmark measurement; the experiment is treated as completed because it is a historical, closed Fermilab fixed-target programme with no source suggesting ongoing operation.

physics_goals.value: Measure direct CP violation in neutral kaon decays (Re(epsilon'/epsilon)) and search for rare KL decays

summary.plain: KTeV was a Fermilab experiment in the 1990s that studied neutral kaon decays, showing that nature's matter-antimatter asymmetry (CP violation) can happen directly inside a kaon's decay, at the same time as CERN's NA48 was making the same discovery.
summary.technical: Fermilab fixed-target kaon experiment (jointly E799-II and E832, together called KTeV / 'Kaons at the Tevatron'), designed 1992, measuring direct CP violation (Re(epsilon'/epsilon)) and rare KL decays; announced its landmark direct-CP-violation observation in 1999. Contemporary and complementary to CERN's NA48.

notes: Derived fields (detector_ids, site_ids, result_ids, document_ids) are deliberately not written (v0.2 A1).

KTeV is jointly E799-II and E832; both INSPIRE experiment records are cited (external.inspire_experiment uses E832's recid, 1108757, since 'KTeV' most commonly denotes the CP-violation programme; E799's recid, 1108830, is also on file at src:ktev-inspire-e799).
No official KTeV website was fetchable this session (fnal.gov returned HTTP 403 / DNS failures for several guessed subdomains); records rely on INSPIRE and the 1992 design report instead.
The commonly cited 1996-1997 and 1999-2000 run-period breakdown was not confirmed by any source fetched this session and is therefore not asserted; see the 'completed' interval note.
